paragraphs.text: Hashaton is a legendary zombie wizard from Amonkhet .
I served the Scarab in an age long past, in another form, under another name. No matter their visage, I serve.

Hashaton is a character who debuted in Aetherdrift Commander as part of the Eternal Might commander deck. They are a follower of the Scarab God since before they became a zombie and before Bolas warped the God's form. As Hashaton has no other species type, they were likely a human before becoming a zombie. Their staff appears to have the face of a leonin on it, possibly implying this was the Scarab God's original form. They are eternalized in lazotep plating and wield a golden staff.
